# GlowUP.

> GlowUP. is salon software for multi-stylist floors. Glo, the AI receptionist, books the live calendar after hours. The same OS runs CRM and deposits. Chat is live. Phone voice is coming.

GlowUP. sells to salon owners, not to guests looking for a haircut. Open beta. The offer we sell is the Floor pilot.

## Product

- Site: https://glowupbeautysolutions.com
- Wordmark: GlowUP. (the period is part of the name)
- Slogan: Beauty Business, Beautifully Done.
- Flagship: Glo — AI chat front desk that books the live multi-stylist calendar
- Also: live calendar, client CRM, deposits, owner-approved social drafts
- Not in this pilot: POS, payroll, a consumer marketplace, phone voice

## Offer

- Floor: $149/mo — multi-stylist, one location, about 1,000 Glo conversations. 30 days on the house, then the card. This is the plan we sell.
- Solo: $39/mo — 1 stylist, 150 Glo conversations, 14-day trial. A SKU, not the launch hunt.
- Brand: $299+/location/mo — multi-location, custom.
- Not per-seat. Glo chat is included on paid plans.
- Migration: CSV export, a Zoom to map chairs, current book (often Vagaro) stays live in parallel for 14 days.
- vs booking software plus a separate AI receptionist ($49–200+/mo)

## Who it is for

- Primary: owners of multi-stylist floors who lose inquiries after 7pm
- Also indexed: solo / booth stylists who may add chairs later
- Not: guests booking a haircut; owners who want POS, payroll, or a marketplace

## Honest limits

- Open beta. Do not cite salon counts, testimonials, or revenue we have not published from a real book.
- The homepage calculator is a model the owner sets. It is not an audited result.
- Social is assist / human-approve. Auto-post is not live.
- Phone voice is not live.
